vendor: Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. (operating as MiniMax / Hailuo AI)
product_family: MiniMax is a foundation-model company (M-series LLMs) whose consumer-facing brands include Hailuo AI (hailuoai.video: text/image-to-video and image generation, 'Hailuo Agent'), MiniMax Chat/Agent, MiniMax Audio (speech/music models), MiniMax Talkie, and a developer API platform (platform.minimax.io) for enterprise/programmatic access.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No trust center, security page, or SOC 2 reference found on hailuoai.video, minimax.io, chat.minimax.io, or platform.minimax.io. Third-party blog commentary explicitly notes SOC 2 claims for MiniMax are unverified and should not be assumed.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No ISO 27001 reference found on any vendor-owned domain (hailuoai.video, minimax.io, chat.minimax.io, platform.minimax.io).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification on any vendor-owned domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR for AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registry listing or self-assessment for MiniMax/Hailuo.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy policy makes no reference to HIPAA, protected health information, or a Business Associate Agreement. Consumer ToS also states the company disclaims responsibility for content and does not offer healthcare-specific safeguards.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: No GDPR-specific certification or compliance statement found; the Hailuo privacy policy only commits to 'appropriate safeguards ... in accordance with applicable data protection laws' in general terms and names a Data Protection Officer contact for Singapore residents (contact.nanonoble@minimax.io), not a GDPR-specific representative or SCC/DPA framework.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; payments are handled via third-party processors per standard SaaS subscription flow but no PCI DSS statement appears on vendor domains.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to this consumer/API product as observed.

privacy.ai_training_note: No vendor-domain page explicitly states whether user prompts, uploads, or generated content are used to train MiniMax/Hailuo models, and no opt-out mechanism is documented publicly. The Hailuo Terms of Service grants the company a broad 'royalty-free, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, non-exclusive' license to use, reproduce, modify, and create derivative works from user-submitted content, which survives termination -- this is a content-license grant, not an explicit training disclosure, but it leaves the door open. Third-party (non-vendor) sources report MiniMax's free-tier terms allow data to be used to 'improve the model' during free periods, but this is unconfirmed on any vendor-owned domain and should be treated as unverified pending direct vendor confirmation.
privacy.data_region: Not disclosed on vendor-owned pages. The Hailuo privacy policy (Nanonoble Pte. Ltd., Singapore) discusses transfers of Singapore residents' data to affiliates/third parties without naming a primary processing region. Multiple independent (non-vendor) sources assert MiniMax's underlying infrastructure and primary data centers are located in mainland China, but this is not confirmed by any vendor-domain source captured here and is flagged as unverified.

security.name: Encryption in transit/at rest
security.value: Not disclosed. Privacy policy uses only generic 'reasonable efforts' language and explicitly disclaims guarantee of internet transmission security; no encryption specifics (TLS version, at-rest encryption, key management) are published on any vendor domain.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure / bug bounty
security.value: No public vulnerability disclosure policy or bug bounty program found on hailuoai.video or minimax.io.

security.name: Trust center / security page
security.value: None found on any vendor-owned domain (hailuoai.video, minimax.io, chat.minimax.io, platform.minimax.io). A third-party review blog (not a vendor domain) hosts an unofficial 'Security' explainer page, which does not count as vendor evidence.

security.name: Enterprise / API data handling
security.value: Enterprise/API customers are directed to contact MiniMax (api@minimax.io) for deployment support and enterprise solutions; data handling terms including DPA appear to be negotiated per-agreement rather than published, per platform terms structure separating Open Platform, Agent, Audio, and Video terms.

products.name: Hailuo AI (hailuoai.video)
products.data_scope: User prompts, uploaded start/end-frame images, account info (email/phone), device and usage data, IP address.
products.notes: Free and paid consumer tiers from $9.99/mo; broad content license granted to the company in ToS; no enterprise-specific safeguards documented for this surface.

products.name: MiniMax Chat / Agent (chat.minimax.io, agent.minimax.io)
products.data_scope: Chat messages, uploaded files, account info.
products.notes: Separate privacy policy from Hailuo video product; same lack of published certifications.

products.name: MiniMax Audio / Talkie
products.notes: Covered by product-specific terms linked from the master ToS overview page; not independently verified in this assessment.

products.name: MiniMax Open Platform / API (platform.minimax.io)
products.category: Developer/enterprise API access to MiniMax models
products.data_scope: API request/response payloads, developer account data.
products.notes: Enterprise-oriented surface; page content was not fully renderable via automated fetch (client-side app), so specific enterprise DPA/training-opt-out terms could not be directly quoted. Prospective enterprise buyers should request documentation directly (api@minimax.io) rather than assume parity with consumer terms.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription (consumer, from $9.99/mo) plus usage-based API pricing for developers/enterprise via platform.minimax.io.
compare.data_residency: Not publicly confirmed on vendor domain; Singapore entity (Nanonoble Pte. Ltd.) operates the consumer products, but primary processing region is not disclosed. Unverified third-party reporting suggests mainland China infrastructure.

flags: Identity-conflation risk: multiple unrelated companies share similar names/domains -- 'Minimax d.o.o.' (minimax.com, minimaxliving.com, fire-safety/cash-register/office-equipment company) and 'Minimax Sustainable AI Ltd' (minimax-sustainable-ai.com) are NOT the same entity as the AI vendor assessed here (Nanonoble Pte. Ltd. / minimax.io / hailuoai.video). Any cert or policy found on those other domains must not be attributed to this vendor.
No trust center or security page exists on any vendor-owned domain; all certification fields are held=false on absence of evidence, not on confirmed non-possession.

AI training data usage on user content is not clearly disclosed; the broad perpetual content-license grant in the Hailuo ToS combined with third-party (unverified) reports of training on free-tier data warrants caution -- flagged as an open question for enterprise buyers.

Data residency/processing region is not stated on any vendor-owned page; only unverified third-party sources claim China-based processing, which is not confirmed here and should not be presented as fact without direct vendor confirmation.
